game.title: New York Giants at Houston Texans

lede: Houston Texans carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#22 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Houston Texans -8.6 with a fair total of 41.5, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is New York Giants pass offence vs Houston Texans pass defence, which sits −0.280 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is quarterback information: New York Giants and Houston Texans have no confirmed starter on file, which materially affects how much confidence the exact number deserves.
